content.text: The data holds only per-zone temperature sensors (plus setpoints). Both a genuine local load increase and a drifting/faulty zone temperature sensor produce an identical signature in a single temperature stream, and there is no load, power, occupancy, or independent reference-temperature stream to cross-check. Therefore the available streams cannot discriminate between the two candidate causes.

input.needed_streams: Zone-level load streams (e.g., Zone_F3_Z01_Electric_Power_Sensor / space heating-cooling energy) and an independent reference temperature for the same space (a redundant/secondary zone temperature sensor or the serving AHU supply-air temperature) to cross-check the Zone_F3_Z01.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor reading.
